name: OmniRoute
summary: MIT AI gateway that routes one endpoint across 359 providers and 1,200+ chat models with quota-aware failover.
description: OmniRoute is an OpenAI-compatible gateway that fronts 359 providers and 1,200+ chat models with zero-config auto combos and 19 routing strategies scored on 16 factors. It adds quota-aware fallback, token compression (15-95%), MCP and A2A support, a CLI, an Electron desktop/PWA dashboard and a tray app; the README catalogues ~1.62B third-party free tokens per month.
contains: one OpenAI-compatible endpoint over 359 providers and 1,200+ chat models
~1.62B free tokens/month catalogued from 489 third-party free-tier entries
zero-config auto combos plus 19 routing strategies and 16-factor scoring
quota-aware auto-fallback across 3 independent resilience layers
CLI, Electron desktop/PWA and tray app; MCP and A2A support
works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, Cline and Copilot
MIT licensed, built by hundreds of contributors
